bachay bhookay hain: food request, children present, raise urgency
raabta nahi ho raha: communications blackout, treat as incident report
madad chahiye: generic help request, infer specifics from context
madad pohnchao: generic help request (imperative), same as madad chahiye -- resource_request, not non_actionable
log pareshan hain: distress call, treat as an actionable generic help request
bijli nahi hai: infrastructure damage, moderate unless combined with a medical need
kho gaya: loss report (property/boats/belongings already gone) -- incident_report or infrastructure_damage, not resource_request
